basis: Eight equally weighted build milestones. Only verified completed milestones contribute to the displayed percentage; software simulation is not proof of a working physical robot.

milestones.title: Challenge scope and architecture
milestones.evidence: Three-week scope, ESP32-S3 / Kratos split and indoor building goal defined.

milestones.title: Interactive website and virtual missions
milestones.evidence: Room queue, Go now, Pause/Resume, route preview and safety simulation built and tested in a browser.

milestones.title: Measure diecast and verify component fit
milestones.evidence: Adjustable fit planner exists; actual shell interior has not been measured or validated.

milestones.title: Assemble drivetrain, power and electronics
milestones.evidence: Motors, battery, wiring and physical E-stop are not verified on a built vehicle.

milestones.title: Integrate real sensing and local safety
milestones.evidence: Depth sensor, encoders, IMU, markers and motor control need physical calibration.

milestones.title: Deploy Kratos website, MQTT and telemetry
milestones.evidence: FastAPI/MQTT examples exist but are not deployed to the live server or vehicle.

milestones.title: Survey IS second-floor route and relocalize
milestones.evidence: Current C-shaped hallway map is schematic; actual room locations and localization remain unverified.

milestones.title: Demonstrate supervised room-to-room mission
milestones.evidence: Physical routes (e.g., 251 → 263 → 251 → 202), arrival chime and turn signals need tests.
